fresenius-se-co-kgaa.name: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA
fresenius-se-co-kgaa.hq: Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany
fresenius-se-co-kgaa.description: Fresenius SE & Co. KGaA is a German multinational health care company based in Bad Homburg vor der Höhe. It provides dialysis products and services, inpatient and outpatient medical care, hospital management, and engineering services for medical centers. The company was ranked 411th in the 2023 Forbes Global 2000 list.

fgc-ues.name: FGC UES
fgc-ues.description: SOE FGC UES is a state-owned energy company based in Moscow, Russia. It is Russia's largest supplier of electrical power, operating in the electric power industry.

flex-ltd.name: Flex Ltd.
flex-ltd.description: Flex Ltd. is a Singaporean multinational manufacturing company specializing in electronics manufacturing services and original design manufacturing. It is the world's third largest EMS and ODM company by revenue. The company has its U.S. corporate headquarters in Austin, Texas, and manufacturing operations in over 30 countries.

fresenius-medical-care.name: Fresenius Medical Care
fresenius-medical-care.hq: Bad Homburg vor der Höhe, Germany
fresenius-medical-care.description: Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA is a German healthcare company providing kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient centers. It primarily treats end-stage renal disease requiring lifelong dialysis. The company operates 4,171 dialysis centers serving over 345,000 patients.

fujitsu.name: Fujitsu
fujitsu.description: Fujitsu Limited is a Japanese multinational information and communications technology company headquartered in Kawasaki, Kanagawa. Established in 1935, it is the world's sixth-largest IT services provider by revenue and the largest in Japan as of 2021.

fujifilm-corporation.name: Fujifilm Corporation
fujifilm-corporation.description: Fujifilm Holdings Corporation, trading as Fujifilm, is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in photography, optics, office and medical electronics, biotechnology, and chemicals.

fast-retailing.name: Fast Retailing
fast-retailing.description: Fast Retailing Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational retail holding company. It owns several brands including Uniqlo, J Brand, Comptoir des Cotonniers, GU, Princesse tam.tam, and Theory.

fluor-corporation.name: Fluor Corporation
fluor-corporation.description: Fluor Corporation is an American engineering and construction firm headquartered in Irving, Texas. It operates through subsidiaries in oil and gas, industrial and infrastructure, government, and power sectors.

fielmann.name: Fielmann
fielmann.description: Fielmann Group AG is a German eyewear company.

freescale-semiconductor.name: Freescale Semiconductor
freescale-semiconductor.description: Freescale Semiconductor, Inc. was an American semiconductor manufacturer created in 2004 from Motorola's Semiconductor Products Sector. It focused on integrated circuits for automotive, embedded, and communications markets. The company merged with NXP Semiconductors in 2015.

fiserv.name: Fiserv
fiserv.description: Fiserv, Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It processes debit and credit card transactions, loyalty programs, loans, electronic bill pay, wires and ACH transfers, check deposits, and ATM transactions for banking institutions. It also produces debit and credit cards and point of sale terminals.

foton-motor.name: Foton Motor
foton-motor.description: Foton Motor is a Chinese company that designs and manufactures trucks, buses, and sport utility vehicles. It is headquartered in Changping, Beijing, and operates as a subsidiary of the BAIC Group.

flowserve.name: Flowserve
flowserve.description: Flowserve Corporation is an American multinational headquartered in Irving, Texas. It supplies industrial and environmental machinery such as pumps, valves, and seals to power, oil, gas, and chemical industries. The company was formed in 1997 from a merger of BW/IP and Durco International.

fortinet.name: Fortinet
fortinet.description: Fortinet, Inc. is an American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products such as firewalls, endpoint security, and intrusion detection systems, with offices in the US, Canada, and UK.

fibria.name: Fibria
fibria.description: Fibria Celulose was a Brazilian pulp and paper company formed by merging Aracruz Celulose and Votorantim Celulose e Papel. It had production capacity exceeding six million tons across seven factories in five Brazilian states and maintained distributor centers worldwide.

fox-corporation.name: Fox Corporation
fox-corporation.description: Fox Corporation is an American multinational mass media company headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, with offices in Burbank, California. It was formed in 2019 as a spin-off of 21st Century Fox's broadcasting, news, and sports assets. The company is controlled by Lachlan Murdoch through a family trust.

fanuc.name: FANUC
fanuc.description: FANUC is a Japanese group of companies providing automation products and services such as robotics and computer numerical control systems. It is the world's largest maker of industrial robots.

flsmidth.name: FLSmidth
flsmidth.description: FLSmidth & Co. A/S is a Danish multinational technology company headquartered in Copenhagen. It provides equipment and services to the global mining and cement industries, including technology for mining metals like copper and gold and for cement production. The company has offices in over 60 countries worldwide.

freenet-ag.name: Freenet AG
freenet-ag.description: Freenet AG is a German telecommunications and web content provider. It was formerly a subsidiary of Mobilcom and merged with Mobilcom in 2007, after which it changed its name to Freenet AG. In 2008, Freenet AG acquired another German telecommunications company, debitel AG.

first-republic-bank.name: First Republic Bank
first-republic-bank.description: First Republic Bank was a commercial bank and wealth management provider headquartered in San Francisco, California. It served high-net-worth individuals with 93 offices in 11 states. The bank was closed and sold to JPMorgan Chase in May 2023 during the US banking crisis.

fox-wizel-ltd.name: Fox-Wizel Ltd.
fox-wizel-ltd.description: Fuchs-Wiesel Inc., known as Fox, is an Israeli clothing retail company. It is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The company operates in the fashion industry.

fiskars.name: Fiskars
fiskars.description: Fiskars Corporation is a Finnish consumer goods company founded in 1649 in Fiskars, Finland. It is one of the oldest continuously operating companies in the world, with global headquarters in Espoo near Helsinki.

finnair.name: Finnair
finnair.description: Finnair Plc is the flag carrier and largest full-service legacy airline of Finland, headquartered in Vantaa at Helsinki Airport. Founded in 1923, it dominates domestic and international air travel in Finland and is a member of the Oneworld alliance. The Finnish State is the majority shareholder.

fti-consulting.name: FTI Consulting
fti-consulting.description: FTI Consulting is a business consultancy firm founded in 1982 and headquartered in Washington, D.C. It specializes in corporate finance, restructuring, economic consulting, forensic and litigation consulting, strategic communications, and technology and strategy consulting. It is one of the largest financial consulting firms worldwide.

fdk-corporation.name: FDK Corporation
fdk-corporation.description: FDK Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of electronic components and batteries. The company is publicly traded, with significant ownership by PSA Group (Taiwan) and Fujitsu. It operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

frontier-developments.name: Frontier Developments
frontier-developments.description: Frontier Developments plc is a British video game developer based in Cambridge, England. Founded in 1994, it develops games including Planet Coaster, Planet Zoo, and titles in the Elite series. The company is listed on the AIM segment of the London Stock Exchange.

fairchild-semiconductor.name: Fairchild Semiconductor
fairchild-semiconductor.description: Fairchild Semiconductor International, Inc. was an American semiconductor company based in San Jose, California. Founded in 1957 by the "traitorous eight," it pioneered transistor and integrated circuit manufacturing before being acquired by ON Semiconductor in 2016.

foxtron.name: Foxtron
foxtron.description: Foxtron Inc., or Foxtron Vehicle Technologies, is a Taiwanese manufacturer of electric cars and buses based in Taipei. Operating since 2020, it is a joint venture between Foxconn and Yulon.

franchise-group.name: Franchise Group
franchise-group.description: Franchise Group, Inc. is an American privately held holding company that acquires and manages franchise companies. Before its 2024 bankruptcy, it owned several retail brands including American Freight and The Vitamin Shoppe.

fosun-pharmaceutical.name: Fosun Pharmaceutical
fosun-pharmaceutical.description: Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical (Group) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company mostly owned by Fosun International. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

fancl-corporation.name: Fancl Corporation
fancl-corporation.description: FANCL Corporation is a Japanese cosmetics and dietary supplements company incorporated in 1981. It operates in the beauty and health sector.

furyu-corporation.name: Furyu Corporation
furyu-corporation.description: FuRyu Corporation is a Japanese entertainment company based in Shibuya, Tokyo. It operates in publishing and development of video games, mobile games, photo-booths, figures, and multimedia content. The company is involved in various entertainment sectors within Japan.

frontier-airlines.name: Frontier Airlines
frontier-airlines.description: Frontier Airlines, Inc. is an American ultra-low-cost airline headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It operates flights to over 120 destinations across the United States, the Caribbean, Mexico, and Central America, with operating bases in 13 cities including Puerto Rico.

fukusima-bank.name: Fukusima Bank
fukusima-bank.description: The Fukushima Bank Ltd. is a Japanese regional bank headquartered in Fukushima City, Fukushima Prefecture. Founded in 1922, it provides banking, leasing, credit card, and credit guarantee services.

fujita-kanko.name: Fujita Kanko
fujita-kanko.description: Fujita Kankō is a leading hospitality company in Japan operating prominent hotels such as Hotel Chinzanso in Tokyo and Kowaku-en in Hakone. It also owns WHG Hotels located in major Japanese cities. The company is based in Japan and is notable for its significant presence in the hotel industry.

fmc-technologies.name: FMC Technologies
fmc-technologies.description: FMC Technologies, Inc. was a North American company producing equipment for hydrocarbon exploration and production. Incorporated in 2000 after FMC Corporation divested its machinery businesses, it merged with Technip in 2017 to form TechnipFMC.

fuyao.name: Fuyao
fuyao.description: Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese glass manufacturing company headquartered in Fuqing, Fujian. Founded in 1987, it is one of the largest automotive glass producers globally, serving major automobile manufacturers. It also produces float and construction glass.

fnc-entertainment.name: FNC Entertainment
fnc-entertainment.description: FNC Entertainment is a South Korean entertainment company founded in 2006 by singer and producer Han Seong-ho. It functions as a record label, talent agency, music production, event management, and music publishing company. Since 2012, it has been based in Cheongdam-dong.

first-financial-bancorp.name: First Financial Bancorp
first-financial-bancorp.description: First Financial Bancorp is a regional bank headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, with operations centers in Springdale, Ohio, and Greensburg, Indiana. Founded in 1863, it holds the sixth oldest national bank charter and operates 131 locations across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, and Illinois. It acquired Irwin Financial Corp in 2009 through a government-assisted transaction.

foster-s-group-limited.name: Foster's Group Limited
foster-s-group-limited.description: Foster's Group Pty. Ltd. was an Australian beer group known for Foster's Lager, now called Carlton & United Breweries since 2011. Founded in 1888 in Melbourne by two American brothers, the brewery was sold a year later.

fantagio.name: Fantagio
fantagio.description: Fantagio is a South Korean entertainment company operating as a record label, talent training and management agency, and movie and K-drama production company. Founded in 2008 as N.O.A. Entertainment, it changed its name to Fantagio in 2011. The company reported operating and net incomes in 2012.

ftse-mib.name: FTSE MIB
ftse-mib.description: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark stock market index for the Borsa Italiana, Italy's national stock exchange. It includes 40 highly liquid and capitalised shares and is operated by Borsa Italiana, part of the Euronext group since 2021.

fico.name: FICO
fico.description: FICO, originally Fair, Isaac and Company, is an American data analytics company based in Bozeman, Montana. Founded in 1956, it is known for its FICO score, a widely used measure of consumer credit risk in the United States.

fairfax-financial.name: Fairfax Financial
fairfax-financial.description: Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited is a Canadian diversified financial holding company headquartered in Toronto. Founded in 1985, it focuses on property and casualty insurance and reinsurance, with operations spanning consumer services, retail, logistics, agriculture, hospitality, and banking globally.

federal-signal-corporation.name: Federal Signal Corporation
federal-signal-corporation.description: Federal Signal Corporation is an American manufacturer based in Downers Grove, Illinois. It produces street sweeper vehicles, public address systems, emergency vehicle equipment, and emergency vehicle lighting. The company serves various public safety and municipal markets.

firstenergy.name: FirstEnergy
firstenergy.description: FirstEnergy Corp. is an American electric utility headquartered in Akron, Ohio. It was established in 1997 through the merger of Ohio Edison and Centerior Energy.

first-horizon-national-corporation.name: First Horizon National Corporation
first-horizon-national-corporation.description: First Horizon Corporation, formerly First Tennessee Bank, is a financial services company based in Memphis, Tennessee. Founded in 1864, it operates through its banking subsidiary in 12 states across the Southeast and is the fourth largest regional bank in that area.

first-quantum-minerals.name: First Quantum Minerals
first-quantum-minerals.description: First Quantum Minerals is a Canadian mining and metals company focused on mineral exploration, development, and mining. Its main product is copper, which accounted for 82% of its revenues as of 2025.

faurecia.name: Faurecia
faurecia.description: Forvia SE, formerly Faurecia SE, is a French global automotive supplier headquartered near Paris. It is a leading manufacturer of automotive parts, specializing in seats, exhaust systems, interior systems, and decorative vehicle components.

flatexdegiro.name: Flatexdegiro
flatexdegiro.description: Flatexdegiro SE is a German listed online brokerage and financial technology company based in Frankfurt am Main. It operates the Flatex, Degiro, and ViTrade brokerage platforms through Flatexdegiro Bank. It is one of Europe's largest retail online brokers.

fortescue-ltd.name: Fortescue Ltd
fortescue-ltd.description: Fortescue is an Australian global metal mining and energy company. It focused on iron ore mining under the name Fortescue Metals Group until merging with Fortescue Energy in 2023. It is the fourth-largest iron ore producer globally and holds the largest tenement area in Western Australia's Pilbara region.

fortis-inc.name: Fortis Inc.
fortis-inc.description: Fortis Inc. is a Canadian electric utility holding company based in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador. It operates in Canada, the United States, Central America, and the Caribbean. The company is involved in electricity generation and distribution.

fostex.name: Fostex
fostex.description: Foster Denki KK is a Japanese electronics company that manufactures loudspeakers and audio equipment. It sells products under the trade name Fostex and is traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

francaise-des-jeux.name: Française des jeux
francaise-des-jeux.description: La Française des Jeux operates the national lottery games in France and the Republic of Ireland. It was formerly government-owned and became partially public in 2018 when the French government sold half its stake. The company also sponsors the FDJ cycling team.

fastjet.name: Fastjet
fastjet.description: Fastjet Limited is an African airline brand that began operations in 2012 in Tanzania. Headquartered in Johannesburg and incorporated in England and Wales, it operates Fastjet Zimbabwe and Federal Airlines, with plans to restart Fastjet Mozambique in 2026.

fidelity-southern-corporation.name: Fidelity Southern Corporation
fidelity-southern-corporation.description: Fidelity Southern Corporation was an American financial holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It wholly owned Fidelity Bank and the LionMark Insurance Company. The company was acquired by Ameris Bancorp in July 2019.

fever-tree.name: Fever-Tree
fever-tree.description: Fevertree Drinks plc, known as Fever-Tree, is a British producer of premium drink mixers. The company was founded in 2004 by Charles Rolls and Tim Warrillow. It is based in the United Kingdom.

fuelcell-energy.name: FuelCell Energy
fuelcell-energy.description: FuelCell Energy, Inc. is a fuel cell company based in Danbury, Connecticut. It designs, manufactures, operates, and services power plants using molten carbonate fuel cells.

farmer-brothers.name: Farmer Brothers
farmer-brothers.description: Farmer Bros. Co. is an American coffee foodservice company based in Fort Worth, Texas. It specializes in manufacturing and distributing coffee, tea, and about 300 other foodservice items used by restaurants and other establishments.

forgerock.name: ForgeRock
forgerock.description: ForgeRock, Inc. was an identity and access management software company headquartered in San Francisco. In August 2023, it was acquired by Thoma Bravo and merged into Ping Identity, with its technology incorporated into the Ping Identity platform.

fifth-street-asset-management.name: Fifth Street Asset Management
fifth-street-asset-management.description: Fifth Street Asset Management Inc. was an American SEC-registered credit-focused asset manager. The firm lent to small and medium-sized businesses with revenues generally between $25 million and $500 million.

factset.name: FactSet
factset.description: FactSet Research Systems Inc. is an American financial data and software company headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut. It provides integrated data and software solutions for financial professionals.

fleetmatics.name: Fleetmatics
fleetmatics.description: Fleetmatics was a provider of software-as-a-service for fleet management based in Dublin, Ireland. It offered web and mobile applications that provided fleet operators with vehicle location, speed, mileage, and fuel usage information, along with field management and job scheduling services.

forum-energy-technologies.name: Forum Energy Technologies
forum-energy-technologies.description: Forum Energy Technologies is an American oilfield products company providing products and services to the oil and gas and renewable industries worldwide.

focus-media-holding.name: Focus Media Holding
focus-media-holding.description: Focus Media Information Technology is a China-based international out-of-home advertising and digital media company founded in 2003. It pioneered the global elevator-based advertising model and operates in over 15 countries across 5 continents. The company has been traded on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 2015.

frieslandcampina-engro-pakistan.name: FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan
frieslandcampina-engro-pakistan.description: FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan Limited is a Pakistani dairy products company based in Karachi. It operates as a subsidiary of the Dutch multinational cooperative FrieslandCampina. The company is part of the dairy industry in Pakistan.

freedom-holding.name: Freedom Holding
freedom-holding.description: Freedom Holding Corp. is an American investment conglomerate headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Founded in 2008 by Timur Turlov in the United States, it offers services including brokerage, asset management, investment banking, and consumer financial services. Its main focus is on the American stock market and markets in Europe and Central Asia.

fixstars-solutions.name: Fixstars Solutions
fixstars-solutions.description: Fixstars Solutions, Inc. is a US software and services company specializing in multi-core processors including Nvidia GPU and CUDA, IBM Power7, and Cell. It also manufactures the world's largest SATA solid-state drives.

faw-tianjin.name: FAW Tianjin
faw-tianjin.description: Tianjin FAW Xiali Automobile Co., Ltd. was an automobile company based in Tianjin, China, and a subsidiary of FAW Group. It designed, developed, manufactured, and distributed automobiles under the Xiali, Vita, and Junpai brands. The company was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.

flutter-entertainment.name: Flutter Entertainment
flutter-entertainment.description: Flutter Entertainment plc is an Irish-American multinational company specializing in sports betting and gambling. It owns several well-known brands including Betfair, FanDuel, and PokerStars. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

flat-glass-group.name: Flat Glass Group
flat-glass-group.description: Flat Glass Group is a publicly listed Chinese glass production company headquartered in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. It operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

first-international-bank-of-israel-ltd.name: First International Bank Of Israel Ltd.
first-international-bank-of-israel-ltd.legal_name: First International Bank Of Israel Ltd.
first-international-bank-of-israel-ltd.description: The First International Bank of Israel is an Israel-based bank serving primarily large corporate clients and end-market consumers.

listings.name: First International Bank Of Israel Ltd.

fortive.name: Fortive
fortive.description: Fortive Corporation is an American industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. It provides technologies for connected workflow solutions and operates in three segments: Intelligent Operating Solutions, Precision Technologies, and Advanced Healthcare Solutions.

federal-realty-investment-trust.name: Federal Realty Investment Trust
federal-realty-investment-trust.description: Federal Realty Investment Trust is a real estate investment trust that invests in shopping centers across the Northeastern United States, Mid-Atlantic states, California, and South Florida. It focuses on retail real estate investments.

flybe.name: Flybe
flybe.description: Flybe was a British airline based in Exeter, England, originally launched in 1979 as Jersey European Airways. It was rebranded as Flybe in 2002 and was at times the largest independent regional airline in Europe.

fubo.name: Fubo
fubo.description: FuboTV, Inc. is an American over-the-top sports streaming television service operating in the United States, Canada, and Spain. It primarily focuses on live sports channels and also operates the live TV streaming service Molotov in France.

fingerprint-cards.name: Fingerprint Cards
fingerprint-cards.description: Fingerprint Cards (FPC) is a Swedish biometrics company founded in 1997 by Lennart Carlson. It develops and produces biometric systems. The company operates in the semiconductor industry.

federal-mogul.name: Federal-Mogul
federal-mogul.description: Federal-Mogul Corporation is an American developer, manufacturer, and supplier of products for automotive, commercial, aerospace, marine, rail, and off-road vehicles, as well as industrial, agricultural, and power-generation applications. It was acquired in February 2022 by Apollo Global Management.

frasers-group.name: Frasers Group
frasers-group.description: Frasers Group plc is a British conglomerate involved in retail, real estate, intellectual property, and investment. It is named after its ownership of the department store chain House of Fraser. The company is based in the United Kingdom and operates primarily in the retail sector.

frontier-communications.name: Frontier Communications
frontier-communications.description: Frontier Communications Parent, Inc. is an American telecommunications company owned by Verizon. It operates a fiber-optic network and provides cloud-based services. The company was previously known as Citizens Utilities Co., Citizens Communications Co., and Frontier Communications Corp.

f5-inc.name: F5, Inc.
f5-inc.description: F5, Inc. is an American technology company specializing in multicloud application delivery, API security, online fraud prevention, zero trust access, and enterprise AI workload security. It provides solutions to enhance application and data security across cloud environments.

first-pacific.name: First Pacific
first-pacific.description: First Pacific Company Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment management and holding company. It operates in Asia with interests in telecommunications, consumer food products, and infrastructure sectors.

french-connection.name: French Connection
french-connection.description: French Connection is a UK-based global retailer and wholesaler of fashion clothing, accessories, and homeware. Founded in the early 1970s by Stephen Marks, it is based in London. The company was acquired by MIP Holdings Ltd in 2021.

fastenal.name: Fastenal
fastenal.description: Fastenal Company is an American distributor of industrial and construction supplies, headquartered in Winona, Minnesota. Founded in 1967, it is the largest fastener distributor in North America and offers supply chain solutions including inventory management and logistics services.

first-hawaiian-bank.name: First Hawaiian Bank
first-hawaiian-bank.description: First Hawaiian, Inc. is an American bank holding company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaiʻi. Its principal subsidiary, First Hawaiian Bank, is the oldest and largest financial institution in Hawaiʻi. The bank offers a range of banking services including deposit products, lending, and wealth management.

fosun-international-limited.name: Fosun International Limited
fosun-international-limited.description: Fosun International Limited is a Chinese multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in Shanghai and incorporated in Hong Kong. Founded in 1992, it operates in over 35 countries and is one of China's largest privately owned conglomerates.

fresnillo-plc.name: Fresnillo plc
fresnillo-plc.description: Fresnillo plc is a Mexican precious metals mining company incorporated in the United Kingdom and headquartered in Mexico City. It is the world's largest producer of silver from ore and Mexico's second-largest gold miner. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

fastly.name: Fastly
fastly.description: Fastly, Inc. is an American cloud computing company based in San Francisco. It provides content delivery network services, image optimization, load balancing, and cloud security services including denial-of-service attack protection and web application firewall.

fossil.name: Fossil
fossil.description: Fossil Group, Inc. is an American fashion design and manufacturing company founded in 1984 and based in Richardson, Texas. It owns multiple brands including Fossil and Skagen Denmark, and produces licensed accessories for various well-known brands.

funai.name: Funai
funai.description: Funai Electric Co., Ltd. was a Japanese consumer electronics company headquartered in Daitō, Osaka. It produced its own branded electronic products and acted as an OEM for major corporations like Sharp and Toshiba. The company supplied printer hardware technology to Dell and Lexmark and produced printers under the Kodak name.

fix-price.name: Fix Price
fix-price.description: Fix Price is a Russian discount variety store chain operating in multiple countries including Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and others. By October 2023, it operated 6,141 stores. The company focuses on retail in the discount variety segment.

first-media.name: First Media
first-media.description: PT First Media Tbk is an Indonesian media and telecommunications company focused on pay cable television and Internet services. It operates primarily in Indonesia's telecommunications sector. The company provides media and internet connectivity solutions.

fnac-darty.name: Fnac Darty
fnac-darty.description: Fnac Darty SA is a multinational retail company headquartered in Ivry-sur-Seine, France. It adopted its current name after acquiring Darty plc in 2016. The company operates in the retail sector.

fuji-electric.name: Fuji Electric
fuji-electric.description: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electrical equipment manufacturer producing pressure transmitters, flowmeters, gas analyzers, controllers, inverters, pumps, generators, ICs, motors, and power equipment. It operates under the brand name FE.

firstcash.name: FirstCash
firstcash.description: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. is an American pawnshop company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates retail pawn stores in the U.S. and Latin America and is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange.

f-secure.name: F-Secure
f-secure.description: F-Secure Corporation is a Finnish global cybersecurity and privacy company based in Helsinki. It develops and sells antivirus, VPN, password management, and other consumer cybersecurity products for various devices, and offers several free tools on its website.

fuller-s-brewery.name: Fuller's Brewery
fuller-s-brewery.description: Fuller's Brewery, located in Chiswick, west London, England, was the brewing division of Fuller, Smith & Turner PLC from its foundation in 1845 until it was sold to Japanese Asahi Breweries in 2019.

frontline.name: Frontline
frontline.description: Frontline PLC is an oil tanker shipping company based in Limassol, Cyprus. It is the world's fifth largest in its sector and is controlled by John Fredriksen. The company primarily transports crude oil and operates a large fleet of tankers including VLCC and Suezmax vessels.

faw-car-company.name: FAW Car Company
faw-car-company.description: FAW Car Company Limited is a subsidiary of FAW Group based in Changchun, Jilin, China. It has been listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange since 1997 and produces passenger car marques including Hongqi, Bestune, FAW, and Oley.

fbr-capital-markets.name: FBR Capital Markets
fbr-capital-markets.description: FBR & Co. was a capital markets firm headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, founded in 1989. It provided investment banking, merger and acquisition advisory, institutional brokerage, and research services across multiple sectors before being sold to B. Riley Financial in 2017.

fly-leasing.name: FLY Leasing
fly-leasing.description: FLY Leasing is an aircraft leasing investment company based in Ireland. It focuses on leasing aircraft to various customers in the aviation sector.

fnb-corporation.name: FNB Corporation
fnb-corporation.description: FNB Corporation is a diversified financial services corporation headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It is the holding company for First National Bank and operates more than 355 offices across several major metropolitan areas in the United States. The company employs over 4,600 people.

fairpoint-communications.name: FairPoint Communications
fairpoint-communications.description: FairPoint Communications, Inc. was an American telecommunications operator headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It provided local and long-distance phone service, data, internet, broadband, television, and fiber services across 31 markets in 17 states, mainly in rural areas. The company was involved in acquiring Verizon landline operations alongside Frontier Communications.

fairway-market.name: Fairway Market
fairway-market.description: Fairway Market is an American grocery chain founded in 1933 in New York City. After financial difficulties and two Chapter 11 bankruptcies, the brand was acquired by Wakefern Food Corporation. Four stores continue to operate under the Wakefern cooperative member Village Super Markets, including the flagship location in Manhattan.

falconstor-software.name: FalconStor Software
falconstor-software.description: FalconStor Software, Inc. is a data management software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates in the software industry, providing data management solutions.

famous-dave-s.name: Famous Dave's
famous-dave-s.description: Famous Dave's of America, Inc. is a chain of barbecue restaurants primarily located in the Midwestern United States. Founded in 1994 near Hayward, Wisconsin, it serves pork ribs, chicken, beef brisket, and various barbecue sauces. The chain expanded across the U.S. and Puerto Rico, though Puerto Rico locations closed after Hurricane Maria. It has locations in 30 U.S. states and four international cities.

fantasia-holdings.name: Fantasia Holdings
fantasia-holdings.description: Fantasia Holdings Group Company Limited is a leading property developer in China. It operates in five segments including property development, investment, operation services, agency services, and hotel services. The company also provides tourism, entertainment, and interior design services.

far-eastone.name: Far EasTone
far-eastone.description: Far EasTone Telecommunications Co., Ltd., marketed as FET, is a telecommunications company based in Taiwan. It is the third largest telecommunications provider in Taiwan, following Chunghwa Telecom and Taiwan Mobile.

federal-agricultural-mortgage-corporatio.name: Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation
federal-agricultural-mortgage-corporatio.description: The Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation, also known as Farmer Mac, is a federally chartered corporation in the United States established in 1988. It creates a secondary market for agricultural real estate and housing mortgage loans to support farmers, ranchers, and rural communities.

federated-hermes.name: Federated Hermes
federated-hermes.description: Federated Hermes is an investment manager headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States. Founded in 1955, it offers a range of investment strategies including equity, fixed-income, and alternative markets to various clients including corporations and government entities.

ferguson-enterprises.name: Ferguson Enterprises
ferguson-enterprises.description: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. is the largest U.S. distributor of plumbing, HVAC, appliances, lighting, and water products. Headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, it operates numerous distribution centers and branches across the United States and Canada.

ferrellgas.name: Ferrellgas
ferrellgas.description: Ferrellgas Partners, L.P. is an American propane supplier founded in 1939 in Atchison, Kansas. The company is headquartered in Liberty, Missouri and operates nationwide.

ferro-corporation.name: Ferro Corporation
ferro-corporation.description: Ferro Corporation is an American producer of technology-based performance materials for manufacturers, focusing on performance colors, pigments, porcelain enamel, and tile coatings. Founded in 1919 by Harry D. Cushman in Cleveland, it is currently headquartered in Mayfield Heights, Ohio.

fiberhome-networks.name: Fiberhome Networks
fiberhome-networks.description: FiberHome Telecommunication Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese networking and telecommunication equipment provider headquartered in Hongshan District, Wuhan, Hubei province. Founded in 1999, it is one of eight affiliated companies specializing in IP networks under FiberHome Company.

fidelity-guaranty-life.name: Fidelity & Guaranty Life
fidelity-guaranty-life.description: F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. is a public company founded in 1959 and headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. It primarily provides annuities, life insurance, and pension buyout services.

financial-street-holding.name: Financial Street Holding
financial-street-holding.description: Financial Street Holding Company Limited is a listed company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange that mainly sells and leases high-end business real estate in Beijing Financial Street area. It also develops high technology products and provides parking services.

fineos.name: Fineos
fineos.description: Fineos is a software development company founded in 1993 that provides enterprise software for insurance and government social insurance. The company is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with offices in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand.

finisar.name: Finisar
finisar.description: Finisar Corporation manufactures optical communication components and subsystems. Founded in 1987 in Menlo Park, California, it merged with Optium Corporation in 2008 and was acquired by II-VI Incorporated in 2019.

finish-line-inc.name: Finish Line, Inc.
finish-line-inc.description: Finish Line, Inc. is an American retail chain selling athletic shoes and related apparel. Founded in 1976 and headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, it operates stores in 40 states and Puerto Rico, as well as branded departments in Macy's stores.

first-bancorp.name: First Bancorp
first-bancorp.description: First Bancorp is an American bank holding company headquartered in Southern Pines, North Carolina. It operates as First Bank in North Carolina and South Carolina.

first-bancorp-united-state.name: First BanCorp
first-bancorp-united-state.description: First BanCorp is a publicly traded financial holding company located in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

first-citizens-bancshares.name: First Citizens BancShares
first-citizens-bancshares.description: First Citizens Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company based in Raleigh, North Carolina. It operates First Citizens Bank with over 500 branches in 23 states and owns Silicon Valley Bank with 39 offices in 15 states. It is one of the largest banks in the United States.

first-commonwealth-bank.name: First Commonwealth Bank
first-commonwealth-bank.description: First Commonwealth Financial Corporation is a financial services company based in Indiana, Pennsylvania. It primarily serves Western and Central Pennsylvania as well as Canton and Columbus in Ohio. The company operates in the banking sector.

first-community-bancshares.name: First Community Bancshares
first-community-bancshares.description: First Community Bankshares, Inc. is a bank holding company and parent of First Community Bank of Bluefield, Virginia. It operates 45 locations across Virginia, West Virginia, North Carolina, and two in Tennessee. As of 2023, it had $3.6 billion in assets.

first-federal-bank-of-the-midwest.name: First Federal Bank of the Midwest
first-federal-bank-of-the-midwest.legal_name: First Federal Bank of the Midwest
first-federal-bank-of-the-midwest.description: Premier Financial Corp., headquartered in Defiance, Ohio, is the holding company for Premier Bank. Premier Bank operates 73 branches and 9 loan offices across Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. It is a regional banking company.

listings.name: First Federal Bank of the Midwest

first-financial-bank.name: First Financial Bank
first-financial-bank.description: First Financial Bank is a regional bank operated by First Financial Corporation based in Terre Haute, Indiana. It is the oldest national bank in Indiana and the fifth oldest in the United States. The corporation is Vigo County's only publicly traded company.

first-internet-bank-of-indiana.name: First Internet Bank of Indiana
first-internet-bank-of-indiana.description: First Internet Bank of Indiana is the sole subsidiary of First Internet Bancorp, headquartered in Fishers, Indiana. It was established as one of the first state-chartered banks to operate exclusively online and via telephone without physical branches.

first-interstate-bank.name: First Interstate Bank
first-interstate-bank.description: First Interstate BancSystem, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Billings, Montana. It owns First Interstate Bank, a community bank with locations in 14 states across the Western and Midwestern United States. It is the largest bank based in Montana by total assets.

first-merchants-corporation.name: First Merchants Corporation
first-merchants-corporation.description: First Merchants Corporation is a financial holding company headquartered in Muncie, Indiana. It includes First Merchants Bank and First Merchants Private Wealth Advisors, offering commercial and personal banking as well as investment advisory services.

first-midwest-bancorp.name: First Midwest Bancorp
first-midwest-bancorp.description: First Midwest Bancorp, Inc. was headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, near O'Hare Airport. The company originated in Joliet, Illinois, and expanded to serve Chicago suburbs, northwest Indiana, downstate Illinois, southeast Wisconsin, and the Quad Cities area including Iowa.

first-national-of-nebraska.name: First National of Nebraska
first-national-of-nebraska.description: First National of Nebraska, Inc. is an interstate bank holding company based in Omaha, Nebraska. It is the parent company of First National Bank of Omaha and is primarily owned by the Lauritzen family. It is the oldest national bank headquartered west of the Missouri River.

first-niagara-bank.name: First Niagara Bank
first-niagara-bank.description: First Niagara Bank was a regional banking corporation headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It was insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and was the 44th-largest bank in the United States by assets as of mid-2013. Its parent company was First Niagara Financial Group, Inc.

first-horizon-bank.name: First Horizon Bank
first-horizon-bank.description: First Horizon Corporation, formerly First Tennessee Bank, is a financial services company based in Memphis, Tennessee. It operates through its banking subsidiary, First Horizon Bank, providing services across 12 states in the Southeastern US. It is the fourth largest regional bank in that region.

five-below.name: Five Below
five-below.description: Five Below, Inc. is an American chain of specialty discount gift shops headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2002, it targets tweens and teens with most products priced up to $5 and some up to $40. By 2014, it had over 1,850 stores across the United States.

flagstar-bank.name: Flagstar Bank
flagstar-bank.description: Flagstar Bank was an American commercial bank headquartered in Troy, Michigan, founded in 1987. It operated as a consumer and commercial bank and mortgage lender. After acquisition by New York Community Bancorp in 2022, the brand and corporate names underwent changes through 2025.

flowers-foods.name: Flowers Foods
flowers-foods.description: Flowers Foods, Inc. is headquartered in Thomasville, Georgia, and produces and markets packaged bakery foods in the United States. It operates 44 bakeries across 19 states producing bread, snack cakes, tortillas, and pastries. It is the second-largest baking company in the U.S.

fongs-industries-group.name: Fong’s Industries Group
fongs-industries-group.description: CHTC Fong's Industries Co., Ltd., founded in 1963, focuses on designing, developing, manufacturing, and selling textile dyeing and finishing machinery. It was one of the first Hong Kong companies to enter the textile dyeing finishing market in China.

formula-systems-1985-ltd.name: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd.
formula-systems-1985-ltd.description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. is a publicly traded holding company headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel. It operates mainly in information technology through its subsidiaries. In 2010, Polish software maker Asseco acquired a majority stake in the company.

fortune-brands-home-security.name: Fortune Brands Home & Security
fortune-brands-home-security.description: Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. is an American manufacturer of home and security products headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois. Its brands include Moen, Master Lock, and MasterBrand Cabinets. It is a Fortune 500 company and part of the S&P 400 Index.

foundation-coal.name: Foundation Coal
foundation-coal.description: Foundation Coal Holdings, Inc. was a large American coal mining company with offices in Linthicum Heights, Maryland. It operated coal mines in Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Wyoming. It merged with Alpha Natural Resources in 2009 to form the third largest American coal company.

foxit.name: Foxit
foxit.description: Fujian Foxit Software Development Joint Stock Co., Ltd., known as Foxit Software, is a software developer based in Fuzhou, China. It develops PDF software and tools and has subsidiaries and offices in multiple countries including the United States and Germany.

franco-nevada.name: Franco-Nevada
franco-nevada.description: Franco-Nevada Corporation is a gold-focused royalty and streaming company based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It has a diversified portfolio of cash-flow producing assets and is traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange.

fred-s.name: Fred's
fred-s.description: Fred's Inc. was a retail store chain headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, operating in 15 southeastern U.S. states. It operated both pharmacies and discount general merchandise stores but announced multiple store closures in 2019, significantly reducing its number of locations.

freelancer-com.name: freelancer.com
freelancer-com.description: Freelancer is an Australian freelance marketplace website founded in 2009 and headquartered in Sydney. It allows employers to post jobs that freelancers can bid on. The company also has offices in Vancouver, London, Buenos Aires, Manila, and Jakarta.

freshii.name: Freshii
freshii.description: Freshii is a Canadian fast casual restaurant franchise founded in 2005 by Matthew Corrin. It serves burritos, wraps, soups, salads, and frozen yogurt, and has expanded to over 100 locations across multiple countries including Canada, the United States, and Sweden.

freshpet.name: Freshpet
freshpet.description: Freshpet, Inc. is an American pet food company that markets fresh cat and dog food products requiring refrigeration. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol FRPT.

full-house-resorts.name: Full House Resorts
full-house-resorts.description: Full House Resorts, Inc. is an American casino developer and operator based in Summerlin South, Nevada. The company operates five casinos and has had notable figures such as Allen Paulson and Lee Iacocca involved in its history.

fulton-financial-corporation.name: Fulton Financial Corporation
fulton-financial-corporation.description: Fulton Financial Corporation is an American regional financial services holding company headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

funko.name: Funko
funko.description: Funko Inc. is an American company that manufactures licensed pop culture collectibles including vinyl figurines and bobbleheads. Founded in 1998 by Mike Becker, its first bobblehead was of the Big Boy restaurant mascot.

furukawa-electric.name: Furukawa Electric
furukawa-electric.description: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in electric and electronics equipment.

figs.name: FIGS
figs.description: Figs, Inc. is an American clothing company based in Santa Monica, California. It sells scrubs and other apparel products for healthcare professionals and was founded in 2013 by Heather Hasson and Trina Spear.

fxcm.name: FXCM
fxcm.description: FXCM, also known as Forex Capital Markets, is a retail foreign exchange broker based in London. It offers trading on the foreign exchange market and provides contracts for difference on major indices and commodities such as gold and crude oil.

ferguson-enterprises-united-kingd.name: Ferguson Enterprises
ferguson-enterprises-united-kingd.description: Ferguson Enterprises Inc. is the largest U.S. distributor of plumbing, HVAC, appliances, lighting, pipes, valves, fittings, and water products. It is headquartered in Newport News, Virginia, and operates primarily in the United States and Canada. The company manages a vast network including 11 regional distribution centers and nearly 1,750 branches.

flagstar-financial.name: Flagstar Financial
flagstar-financial.description: Flagstar Bank, N.A. is an American regional financial services holding company headquartered in Hicksville, New York. In 2023, it operated 395 branches under various bank names, which were rebranded under the Flagstar name in February 2024.

frontera-energy.name: Frontera Energy
frontera-energy.description: Frontera Energy is a Canadian petroleum exploration and production company focused on heavy crude oil and natural gas in Colombia and Peru. It was formerly known as Pacific Rubiales and Pacific Exploration and Production before renaming itself in 2017 and relisting on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

froya-banki.name: Føroya Banki
froya-banki.description: Føroya Banki is a financial services company based in the Faroe Islands providing banking and insurance services. It also operates in Greenland as Bankivik and holds about 40% market share in the Faroe Islands.

franklin-templeton-investments.name: Franklin Templeton Investments
franklin-templeton-investments.description: Franklin Templeton, Inc. is an American multinational investment management holding company founded in New York City in 1947. It operates globally in over 150 countries and was formed through a 1992 merger with Templeton, Galbraith & Hansberger.

founder-technology.name: Founder Technology
founder-technology.description: Founder Technology Group Corporation is a state-owned information technology enterprise based in Shanghai, China. It is a subsidiary of Founder Group from Peking University. The company develops personal computers, computer peripherals under the brand "Fang Zheng," and printed circuit boards.

forrester.name: Forrester
forrester.description: Forrester Research, Inc. is a US research and advisory firm headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It provides research, consulting, and events services to large global business, technology, and consumer enterprises.

fujiya.name: Fujiya
fujiya.description: Fujiya Co. Ltd. is a nationwide chain of confectionery stores and restaurants in Japan. Its first shop was founded in 1910 in Yokohama.

farm-fresh.name: Farm Fresh
farm-fresh.description: Farm Fresh Berhad is a Malaysian dairy products company based in Sedili, Johor, founded in 2009. It operates two factories in Pahang and Johor with significant production capacity. The Malaysian sovereign wealth fund Khazanah Nasional was a substantial shareholder but divested its shares in September 2025.

fmc-corporation.name: FMC Corporation
fmc-corporation.description: FMC Corporation is an American chemical manufacturing company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1883 as an insecticide producer, it diversified into other industries including manufacturing amphibious tracked landing vehicles during WWII. The company employs 7,000 people worldwide.

fiesta-restaurant-group.name: Fiesta Restaurant Group
fiesta-restaurant-group.description: Fiesta Restaurant Group is an American restaurant chain headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It primarily owns Pollo Tropical branded locations in Florida and was spun off from Carrols Restaurant Group in 2012.

fsp-technology.name: FSP Technology
fsp-technology.description: FSP Technology Inc. is a global power supply unit manufacturer headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Founded in 1993, it started with PC power supplies and expanded into industrial, server, medical, telecommunications, and renewable energy systems.

fiat-s-p-a.name: Fiat S.p.A.
fiat-s-p-a.description: Fiat S.p.A., commonly known as Fiat Group, was an Italian holding company primarily involved in the automotive industry.

fonterra.name: Fonterra
fonterra.description: Fonterra Co-operative Group Limited is a New Zealand multinational dairy co-operative owned by New Zealand farmers. It is responsible for about 30% of the world's dairy exports and is New Zealand's largest company. As of 2022, it is the sixth-largest dairy company globally and the largest in the Southern Hemisphere.

fiat-industrial.name: Fiat Industrial
fiat-industrial.description: Fiat Industrial S.p.A. was an Italian company formed in 2011 by demerging Fiat S.p.A.'s non-automobile activities. It served as a holding company for truck manufacturer Iveco, an 89.3% stake in CNH Global, and FPT Industrial. Sergio Marchionne was the company's chairman.

financial-group-banamex.name: Financial Group Banamex
financial-group-banamex.description: Grupo Financiero Banamex S.A. de C.V. is the holding company of Banco Nacional de México, known as Banamex. It is one of Mexico's largest banks and was acquired by Citigroup in 2001. The bank operated as a Citigroup subsidiary and was rebranded as Citibanamex until 2025, after which Citigroup sold portions to other investors.

ford-do-brasil.name: Ford do Brasil
ford-do-brasil.description: Ford Motor Company Brasil Ltda. is the Brazilian subsidiary of the American automaker Ford Motor Company. Founded in 1919, it initially imported Ford Model T cars and Model TT trucks for assembly in Brazil. The Ford brand has been present in Brazil since 1904.

far-eastern-shipping-company.name: Far Eastern Shipping Company
far-eastern-shipping-company.description: FESCO Transportation Group is a Russian intermodal transport operator headquartered in Moscow. It provides marine shipping, rail transportation, and port handling services. The parent company is Far-Eastern Shipping Company JSC.

first-city-monument-bank.name: First City Monument Bank
first-city-monument-bank.description: First City Monument Bank (FCMB) is a financial services holding company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It has nine subsidiaries across commercial and retail banking, investment banking, and asset and wealth management. FCMB Group Plc is the parent company.

future-plc.name: Future plc
future-plc.description: Future plc is a British publishing company founded in 1985 by Chris Anderson. It is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange.

farstad-shipping.name: Farstad Shipping
farstad-shipping.description: Farstad Shipping is a publicly listed supply shipping company headquartered in Ålesund, Norway. It employs approximately 2,200 people, with the majority working offshore. The company operates in the shipping industry.

funcom.name: Funcom
funcom.description: Funcom Oslo AS is a Norwegian video game developer and publisher specializing in online games. It is known for MMORPG titles like Conan Exiles and Age of Conan. The company has offices in multiple countries and is owned by Tencent.

fortress-biotech.name: Fortress Biotech
fortress-biotech.description: Fortress Biotech Inc., also known as Fortress Bio, is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Bay Harbor Islands, Florida. It acquires, develops, and commercializes pharmaceutical and biotechnology products. The company is led by CEO Lindsay A. Rosenwald, M.D.

fairfield-enterprises.name: Fairfield Enterprises
fairfield-enterprises.description: Fairfield Enterprises was a British machine distributor and supplier of tooling and support services to the printing and packaging industries. It was taken over in 2000 by Swiss company Bobst AG.

ferrum-sa.name: FERRUM SA
ferrum-sa.description: FERRUM SA is an ironworks company established in 1874 and located in Katowice, Poland. It is a key producer of large diameter steel pipes used in various industries including petrochemical, heating, water, sewage, hydrotechnics, energy, and construction. The company is listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.

fidessa.name: Fidessa
fidessa.description: Fidessa group Holdings Ltd is a British-headquartered company providing financial markets software and services. Its offerings include trading and investment management systems, analytics, and market data for buy side and sell side clients in the financial services sector.

finning.name: Finning
finning.description: Finning is a Canadian industrial equipment dealer specializing in Caterpillar products. It sells, rents, and provides parts and service for equipment used in mining, construction, petroleum, forestry, and power systems. It is the largest Caterpillar dealer worldwide.

farnell-element14.name: Farnell element14
farnell-element14.description: Premier Farnell Ltd. is a distributor of electronic system design, maintenance, and repair products operating in 36 countries across Europe, North America, and Asia Pacific. In 2016, it was acquired by Avnet in a deal valued at approximately £691 million.

ftse-jse-top-40-index.name: FTSE/JSE Top 40 Index
ftse-jse-top-40-index.description: The FTSE/JSE Top 40 Index is a South African stock market index comprising the 40 largest stocks by market capitalization on the JSE Limited, part of the FTSE/JSE All-Share Index.

founder-group.name: Founder Group
founder-group.description: Founder Group is a major Chinese technology conglomerate involved in information technology, pharmaceuticals, real estate, finance, and commodities trading. It is divided into five major industry groups and has been undergoing bankruptcy restructuring since 2020.

ferrexpo.name: Ferrexpo
ferrexpo.description: Ferrexpo plc is a Swiss-based commodity trading and mining company, the third largest exporter of iron ore pellets worldwide. Its operations are based in central Ukraine, and its trading office is in London where it is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

first-american-corporation.name: First American Corporation
first-american-corporation.description: First American Financial Corporation is an American financial services company providing title insurance and settlement services to the real estate and mortgage industries.

foxtons.name: Foxtons
foxtons.description: Foxtons Group plc is a British estate agency company dealing with lettings and sales. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

fasing.name: Fasing
fasing.description: FASING Plc. is a Polish multinational metal industry corporation and one of the largest chain manufacturers globally. It is the largest producer of industrial chains in Central and Eastern Europe, supplying products used in mining, energy, fishing, and transport sectors.

first-bank-of-nigeria.name: First Bank of Nigeria
first-bank-of-nigeria.description: First Bank of Nigeria is a multinational bank and financial services company headquartered in Lagos. Founded in 1894 by Sir Alfred Jones, it is owned by First HoldCo PLC with over 1.3 million shareholders.

fidelity-bank-nigeria.name: Fidelity Bank Nigeria
fidelity-bank-nigeria.description: Fidelity Bank Plc is a commercial bank headquartered in Victoria Island, Lagos, Nigeria. It is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria with international authorization. The bank offers various financial services.

first-nation-airways.name: First Nation Airways
first-nation-airways.description: First Nation Airways Ltd. was a Nigerian airline headquartered in Lagos with its base at Murtala Mohammed Airport. It operated within the Nigerian airline industry.

federal-mortgage-bank-of-nigeria.name: Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria
federal-mortgage-bank-of-nigeria.description: The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria was founded by the Nigerian government in 1977 to replace the Nigerian Building Society. It was the only mortgage institution in Nigeria between 1978 and 1985 and was established to meet the housing needs of all Nigerian citizens.

fina-bank.name: Fina Bank
fina-bank.description: Guaranty Trust Bank (Rwanda) plc, commonly known as GTBank Rwanda, is a licensed commercial bank in Rwanda. It has been part of the Nigerian Guaranty Trust Bank since 2013, operating in the financial services sector.

fly-6ix.name: Fly 6ix
fly-6ix.description: Fly 6ix was a passenger airline headquartered in Freetown, Sierra Leone. It operated flights out of Lungi International Airport before ceasing operations.

fly540.name: Fly540
fly540.description: Fly540 was a low-cost airline based in Nairobi, Kenya, that commenced operations in 2006 offering passenger and cargo services. It had subsidiaries in Ghana and Angola and ceased operations in September 2022 before entering receivership in August 2026.

forestry-commission-of-ghana.name: Forestry Commission of Ghana
forestry-commission-of-ghana.description: The Forestry Commission is a government agency in Ghana under the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources. It is responsible for forestry-related activities in the country.

ferrous-resources.name: Ferrous Resources
ferrous-resources.description: Ferrous Resources Ltda. is a Brazilian mining company involved in the research, exploration, exploitation, processing, and marketing of iron ore. It operates within Brazil's mining sector.

flyer-industria-aeronautica.name: Flyer Indústria Aeronáutica
flyer-industria-aeronautica.description: Flyer Indústria Aeronáutica, Ltda. is a Brazilian manufacturer of light aircraft headquartered in Sumaré, São Paulo. It is part of Brazil's aerospace industry.

federation-of-industries-of-the-state-of.name: Federation of Industries of the State of São Paulo
federation-of-industries-of-the-state-of.legal_name: Federation of Industries of the State of São Paulo
federation-of-industries-of-the-state-of.description: The Federation of Industries of the State of São Paulo (FIESP) is a Brazilian industry entity affiliated with the National Industry Confederation (CNI). It represents industrial interests in the state of São Paulo.

free-lives.name: Free Lives
free-lives.description: Free Lives is an independent video game developer based in Cape Town, South Africa. Founded in April 2012 and led by creative director Evan Greenwood, the company is known for creating the video game Broforce. It has also developed the comedy game Genital Jousting and the virtual reality game Gorn.

federal-air.name: Federal Air
federal-air.description: Federal Air is a South African airline headquartered at O. R. Tambo International Airport near Johannesburg. It specializes in flights to luxury safari lodges and operates air shuttle, scheduled, and charter services throughout Southern Africa. The airline targets niche tourism markets.

flysafair.name: FlySafair
flysafair.description: FlySafair is a South African international low-cost airline founded in 2013 and headquartered in Johannesburg. It operates flights to 15 destinations in Sub-Saharan Africa with a fleet of 36 aircraft.

falabella-bank.name: Falabella Bank
falabella-bank.description: Banco Falabella is a Chilean bank founded in 1998 and headquartered in Las Condes, Chile. It is a subsidiary of S.A.C.I. Falabella and has branches in Chile, Peru, and Colombia.

famae.name: FAMAE
famae.description: FAMAE is a Chilean state-owned firearms manufacturer. It produces various weaponry including carbines, submachine guns, sniper rifles, and revolvers. Its products are used by the Chilean armed forces and the Carabineros police force.

fibertel-telefonica-telecom.name: Fibertel telefónica telecom
fibertel-telefonica-telecom.hq: Avenida Alicia Moreau de Justo, Argentina
fibertel-telefonica-telecom.description: Fibertel was an Argentine Internet service provider that merged with Cablevisión in 2003, becoming part of Grupo Clarín. It served over a million clients and was the third largest ISP in Argentina. In 2018, it merged with Telecom Argentina.

flow.name: Flow
flow.description: Flow is an Argentine company that provided cable television and internet services in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay. As of 2021, it was integrated into DF Entertainment and Telecom Argentina S.A. The company operated in the mass media sector.

fabricaciones-militares.name: Fabricaciones Militares
fabricaciones-militares.description: Fabricaciones Militares S.A.U. is a state-owned Argentine arms manufacturer based in Buenos Aires. It was formerly a government agency known as Dirección General de Fabricaciones Militares.

ford-argentina.name: Ford Argentina
ford-argentina.description: Ford Argentina S.C.A. is the Argentine subsidiary of Ford Motor Company, founded in Buenos Aires in 1913. It initially assembled Model Ts from kits and is known for producing models like the Ford Focus and the Argentine-adapted Ford Falcon.

fabrica-argentina-de-aviones.name: Fábrica Argentina de Aviones
fabrica-argentina-de-aviones.description: Fábrica Argentina de Aviones SA is Argentina's main aircraft manufacturer located in Córdoba. Founded in 1927, it was known as Fábrica Militar de Aviones until its privatization in the 1990s and is now wholly owned by the Argentine government since 2009.

flybondi.name: Flybondi
flybondi.description: Flybondi, operated by FB Líneas Aéreas S.A., was Argentina's first ultra low-cost airline. It operated Boeing 737-800 aircraft from bases in Buenos Aires and Córdoba. The company used the slogan 'La libertad de volar'.

flora-tristan-center-of-peruvian-women.name: Flora Tristan Center of Peruvian Women
flora-tristan-center-of-peruvian-women.legal_name: Flora Tristan Center of Peruvian Women
flora-tristan-center-of-peruvian-women.description: The Flora Tristán Peruvian Women's Center is a feminist non-governmental organization established in Lima in 1979. It focuses on defending women's human rights and promoting equality.

fly-all-ways.name: Fly All Ways
fly-all-ways.description: Fly All Ways is a regional airline based in Paramaribo, Suriname, which began operations in January 2016. It offers commercial and charter flights to destinations including São Luís in Brazil, Barbados, Curaçao, Sint Maarten, and Guyana. The airline plans to expand service across the Caribbean and South America.

fxpro.name: FxPro
fxpro.description: FxPro is a London-based global online brokerage offering contracts for difference in forex, stocks, futures, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and precious metals. It has offices in London, Cyprus, UAE, and The Bahamas and serves over two million clients worldwide.

faisal-islamic-bank-of-egypt.name: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt
faisal-islamic-bank-of-egypt.description: Faisal Islamic Bank of Egypt SAE is a major Egyptian shariah-compliant financial institution. Incorporated in 1977 and operating since 1979, it offers various commercial banking products and services in Egypt and internationally.

florida-ice-farm-co.name: Florida Ice & Farm Co.
florida-ice-farm-co.description: Florida Ice and Farm Company S.A. is a Costa Rican food and beverages company headquartered in Heredia, Costa Rica. It offers a catalog of over 2000 products sold in more than 15 countries. The company operates in the beverage industry.

fonotica.name: Fonotica
fonotica.description: The Asociación Costarricense de la Industria Fonográfica y Afines (FONOTICA) is a non-profit trade group of multinational and national record companies in Costa Rica. It serves as the affiliate member of the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI) in Costa Rica and acts as the national ISRC agency.

freightliner-daimler-mexico.name: Freightliner-Daimler México
freightliner-daimler-mexico.description: Freightliner-Daimler Vehículos Comerciales México is a manufacturer of trucks and tractors of American origin. Based in Mexico City, its first plant in Mexico opened in Saltillo, Coahuila on February 27, 2009.

flymex.name: FlyMex
flymex.description: FlyMex is a charter airline based in Toluca, Mexico. It operates under the legal name FlyMex, Servicios Integrales de Aviacion S.A. de C.V. The company provides aviation services primarily through charter flights.

flight-express.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

filair.name: Filair
filair.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
filair.description: Filair was an airline based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo operating from N'Dolo Airport in Kinshasa. It was banned by the European Union and Congolese authorities. The airline is no longer active.

free-airlines.name: Free Airlines
free-airlines.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
